title: What lifting and maintenance provisions are needed to replace a lifting roll in a continuous annealing furnace?
summary: Suneng's 2024 continuous stainless-steel annealing furnace documents separate lifting rolls into lifting mechanisms, brackets, seals and roll drives, with a further roll-changing mechanism using an overhead crane. Confirm strip support, lifting at both ends, sealing, drive control and handling space together. Lifting rolls alone do not establish roll changes without stopping production under every operating condition.
